actions.action: Fence session membership with retained deletion markers.
actions.mechanism: Traverse IDs existing at a committed version fence; exclude subsequent inserts and represent subsequent deletions as tombstones.
actions.implementation: Add immutable birth versions, deletion versions, commit-ordered fences, and an ID index spanning tombstones. Sign fence/cursor tokens; expire after ten minutes. Bound scan batches.
actions.check: Under concurrent mutations, compare all emitted IDs with fence-time membership: zero duplicates or omissions. Verify every request finishes within 300 ms.
actions.risk: Filtering can yield short pages; return continuation tokens. Values are current, not historical.

actions.action: Pin an immutable membership tree per session.
actions.mechanism: A pinned root defines exact starting membership without historical queries or transactions spanning requests.
actions.implementation: Store copy-on-write ID-tree nodes in the existing store; atomically publish roots with mutations. Pin roots for ten minutes; fetch current values or deletion markers.
actions.check: Traverse a pinned root during insert/delete churn; assert exact ID-set equality and uniqueness. Benchmark requests against 300 ms, including root publication contention.
actions.risk: Alternative architecture adds write amplification and node reclamation; expired sessions must restart.
